content: भाव्य {%a.%} [भू-ण्यत्] .²1 About to be or happen; मनुस्त्रयोदशो भाव्यः <ls>Bhāg. 8. 13. 30</ls>; <ab>oft.</ab> used impersonally like भवितव्यम् <ab>q. v.</ab>; किं तैर्भाव्यं मम सुदिवसैः <ls>Bh. 3. 41</ls>. .²2 Future. .²3 To be performed or accomplished. .²4 To be conceived or imagined. .²5 To be proved or demonstrated. .²6 To be determined or investigated. .²7 To be convicted; त्र्यवरैः साक्षिभिर्भाव्यो नृपब्राह्मणसंनिधौ <ls>Ms. 8. 60</ls>. .{@-व्यम्@} .²1 What is destined or sure to happen in the future; it is to be; सदा प्रहृष्टया भाव्यं गृहकार्येषु दक्षया <ls>Ms. 5. 150</ls>. .²2 Futurity.
